card.name: Words just before a predictable name
card.fires_on: Small words like 'a', 'be', 'to' and 'in' where a specific, well-known name or term is about to come next, often in a famous phrase or a story about heroes and officials. It also appears at spaces before numbers.

modes.label: Superhero saying
modes.description: Small words inside the phrase about being bitten by a spider to be a superhero.
modes.example: The Global Game Changers believe that you don’t have to be bitten by a spider to be<< a>> superhero.

modes.label: Before numbers
modes.description: A space right before a number in a list or measurement.
modes.example: match the photo of a suspect to one of<< >>10 mug shots, the students came

modes.label: Preposition before an institution
modes.description: A short linking word before a group or agency name.
modes.example: widespread corruption<< in>> the NYPD, was shot and seriously wounded

card.writes: It pushes up first names and titles like Tony, Bruce and Commission, and holds back odd fragments.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words when a proper name or title is likely to follow.
